rows.text: Rs 44.68 cr purchase order from Bhabha Power for 240 compact substations (25 KVA to 1000 KVA), 24-month execution (~23.7% of mcap).
three purchase orders totalling Rs 4.85 cr ex-GST, led by Rs 4.55 cr from Inergy Infra.
Rs 4.135 cr of purchase orders from four customers, including Rs 2.65 cr from Megha Engineering, for EV-charging and electrical equipment (~2.5% of mcap).
H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 52.68 crore, up 90.07% YoY, with Rs 77 crore of orders received and an order book of Rs 173 crore at 30 September.
receives a **Rs 20.02 crore Letter of Award for 57 wind-turbine transformers for Aditya Birla Renewables' Bhuj projects** from an unnamed EPC contractor.
separately reports **Rs 5.28 crore of purchase orders taken since 14 September**, the largest Rs 4.48 crore of inverter-duty transformers for Good Earth Renewable Services.
